description: Register an HTTP resource (base URL + auth: raw header, basic, bearer, or OAuth2 client-credentials) with retry-with-backoff and a one-shot request() helper, for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL for all requests, e.g. 'https://api.example.com/v1'

auth_header_env_var.label: Auth Header Env Var
auth_header_env_var.description: Env var containing the Authorization header value, e.g. 'Bearer token123'

auth_type.label: Auth Type
auth_type.description: Auth scheme, as an alternative to auth_header_env_var: none/basic/bearer/oauth2_client_credentials.

oauth2_client_id_env_var.label: Oauth2 Client Id Env Var
oauth2_client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the OAuth2 client ID. Required for auth_type='oauth2_client_credentials'.

oauth2_client_secret_env_var.label: Oauth2 Client Secret Env Var
oauth2_client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the OAuth2 client secret. Required for auth_type='oauth2_client_credentials'.

retries.label: Retries
retries.description: Retry count per request on a retryable status code / connection error (with exponential backoff). Only applies to request(), not get()/post().

retry_on_status_codes.label: Retry On Status Codes
retry_on_status_codes.description: Response status codes that trigger a retry (in addition to connection/timeout errors, which always retry). Only takes effect when retries > 0.

retry_backoff_seconds.label: Retry Backoff Seconds
retry_backoff_seconds.description: Base delay for exponential backoff between retries (delay = base * 2**attempt).

name: HTTP Resource
